subject: Request: Authorize opening REQ for Inference On‑Call replacement
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Authorize opening REQ for Inference On‑Call replacement

Hi Marissa / Karthik —

Quick one: Sam in Platform Oncall gave notice last week and their last day is 7/2. This was a senior slot (oncall + model-serving runbook ownership). We need authorization to open a backfill requisition (title: Inference On‑Call Engineer) and get recruiting lined up so we don’t regress on SLA coverage in July.

Asks:
- Approve opening headcount (REQ-1123) and sign off on salary band 5 (L7-equivalent comp range).
- Approve we hire via internal + external mix; I’d like Greenfield Recruiting looped for outreach.
- If approved, recruiting to prioritize interviews the week of 6/21 so training overlap is possible.

Attached: latest JD (JD_Inference_Oncall_Engineer_v2.pdf) and draft headcount form (headcount-form-REQ-1123.pdf).

Notes: this is a straight backfill — no net-new FTE. Budget manager is Platform Eng (Marissa).

Thanks — I can present a 5‑min case if that helps.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Staff SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks Dev —

I’ve reviewed the JD and the headcount form. Budget for Platform Eng has enough room this quarter to convert this backfill. I’m OK authorizing the req to be opened, but want confirmation on the proposed salary band and interview panel before we route to People Ops for formal approval.

Vivek — can you confirm the band and the SLA impact statement? Once we have that I’ll sign the headcount form and Priyom can open the req in Greenhouse.

Marissa
Marissa Cole

Marissa / team —

Agree this should be treated as an urgent backfill. Confirming: salary band 5 is appropriate for this role given the scope (oncall rotation + tier‑2 inference incidents + runbook ownership). The expected market midpoint is $185k–$205k base depending on level and location (US).

SLA note: losing this headcount would increase mean time to mitigation for model-serving P0s by ~30% for two weeks during overlap; gap beyond that would require temporary overtime for remaining oncall. Approve on the condition that:
- Recruiting posts the req today (or earliest business day)
- Interview slate includes at least one staff-level infra + one model-serving engineering panelist to evaluate L7 fit

I’ve added a completed headcount justification file to the thread (see attached).

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Authorize opening REQ for Inference On‑Call replacement

Thanks — opening thoughts on the interview plan so recruiting can schedule:

Proposed interview slate (target window 6/21–6/25):
1) 30m Recruiter screen (Priyom / Greenfield)
2) 60m Technical deep‑dive (Dev Patel + inference runtime engineer) — focus: latency optimizations, KV cache behavior, tracing/debugging P0s
3) 45m Systems design (Platform staff engineer) — focus: oncall architecture, runbook design, rollout/fallbacks
4) 30m Team fit / collaboration (Marissa or delegate)

Panel request: please try to avoid scheduling interviews on 6/23 (team offsite). Also prioritise candidates who have at least one year running inference services in production.

Karthik

All —

Thanks, team. I’ll open REQ-1123 in Greenhouse this afternoon with the band Vivek confirmed and the interview slate Karthik proposed. Greenfield — please hold outreach until we’ve confirmed the posting is live, but be prepared to kick off passive sourcing Monday 6/7.

Practical notes: please send any preferred panel times and conflicts to me by COB today so I can draft a scheduling matrix. I’ll attach the formal People Ops submission once Marissa signs the headcount form in Workday.

I’ll also loop the two candidates who previously screened for model-serving infra (including L. Chen) and propose 6/22–6/24 slots first.

—Priyom
